items.t: Scott Galloway Is Buying Nike’s Dip. He Says Its Injury Isn’t “Career Ending”
items.sum: Key TakeawaysScott Galloway made the case for buying Nike on The Prof G Pod, calling its slump an injury that isn’t career-ending. Nike’s own plan has no return to market growth until fiscal 2029, and its 2031 targets still fall short of fiscal 2024’s results.
